title: Tryouts and Playlist
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Sable Okafor, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
